description: Every stable OpenMed error code with the Python classes that carry it and how the REST, gRPC, GraphQL, MCP and CLI surfaces report it today. Every entry is an identifier, status, category or fixed explanation; nothing in this document is request content.

retryable_bases.retry_after_header: REST answers with a Retry-After header.
retryable_bases.retryable_signal: A surface sends an explicit retryable flag or trailer.
retryable_bases.transient_capacity: A capacity or busy refusal whose message says to retry later.
retryable_bases.request_must_change: The same request is refused until the caller changes it.
retryable_bases.configuration_must_change: An operator setting, installed capability or deployment state must change first.
retryable_bases.server_fault: An internal failure the contract says cannot safely continue.
retryable_bases.undetermined: Current behaviour and documentation do not establish retryability.

python.field: code or error_code attribute of the raised exception

grpc.status_details: status details string when no openmed-reason trailer is sent

graphql.http_refusals: HTTP middleware refuses a /graphql request before execution with the REST envelope, recorded under http.

mcp.shape: CallToolResult with isError true and structured content {error: {code, message[, details]}, is_error: true}

divergences.summary: REST and gRPC name the same outcome differently: forbidden and insufficient_scope, service_busy and concurrency_limited, timeout and deadline_exceeded, the 400 and 422 REST input codes and invalid_request, the mTLS codes and the generic gRPC credential reasons, and peer_incompatible and peer_generation_outside_window.
divergences.follow_up: R3 (breaking): coded gRPC ErrorInfo carrying the shared code.

divergences.summary: gRPC reports a Python taxonomy or runtime failure as invalid_request when it is also a ValueError and as internal_error otherwise, so capability, budget, capacity and circuit-breaker categories are lost.
divergences.follow_up: R3 (breaking): coded gRPC ErrorInfo carrying the shared code.

divergences.summary: GraphQL reports every Python taxonomy failure and most runtime refusals inside a resolver as OPENMED_RESOLVER_ERROR.
divergences.follow_up: R3 (breaking): coded GraphQL errors.

divergences.summary: GraphQL mixes upper-case OPENMED_* extension codes with the lower-case codes model_not_served and shutting_down.
divergences.follow_up: R3 (breaking): lower-case GraphQL extensions.code.

divergences.summary: GraphQL reports the service text limit and the service execution timeout inside a resolver as OPENMED_RESOLVER_ERROR; only the GraphQL document budgets and operation deadline have their own codes.
divergences.follow_up: #3545 and R3 (breaking): coded GraphQL errors.

divergences.summary: Once a REST NDJSON stream has started, failures arrive as in-band bad_request events when they are also a ValueError and internal_error events otherwise.
divergences.follow_up: A breaking release: stream error events carry the shared code.

divergences.summary: REST rejects over-limit text and stream chunk sizes during request validation with 422 validation_error.
divergences.follow_up: A breaking release: REST limit failures carry their limit code.

divergences.summary: Shared input-validation leaf codes raised while REST parses a request body are reported as 422 validation_error; MCP reports the leaf code itself.
divergences.follow_up: A breaking release: REST validation details carry the leaf code.

divergences.summary: A drain refusal is not_ready with Retry-After on REST, shutting_down with extensions.retryable on GraphQL, UNAVAILABLE with shutting_down status details and an openmed-retryable trailer on gRPC, and execution_error on MCP. The protocol map still marks the gRPC drain refusal as not applicable.
divergences.follow_up: A breaking release: one drain code on every surface.

divergences.summary: gRPC drain and peer-contract refusals carry their code only in the status details (shutting_down, peer_contract_malformed, peer_generation_outside_window), without an openmed-reason trailer, and are outside the gRPC failure table.
divergences.follow_up: R3 (breaking): coded gRPC ErrorInfo carrying the shared code.

divergences.summary: budget_exceeded is HTTP 503 from the service taxonomy handler and HTTP 413 from the redaction app body and input limits.
divergences.follow_up: A breaking release: one HTTP status per code.

divergences.summary: mcp_error_payload resolves the code from the class name, so a base taxonomy class raised with an instance code, such as InputError with code bad_request, is reported as input_error on MCP while REST reports bad_request.
divergences.follow_up: #5365 (exception rooting) or a later MCP mapper fix.

divergences.summary: MCP reports service runtime refusals that are not OpenMedError subclasses by builtin family: model_not_served as invalid_arguments, and circuit-breaker, warm-pool and drain refusals as execution_error.
divergences.follow_up: #5365 (exception rooting).

divergences.summary: The REST compatibility inventory and the protocol map rest_only_codes list privacy-proxy inbound and outbound codes that no REST route emits as error.code: inbound restoration failures are re-raised as privacy_proxy_response_rejected with details.reason, and the outbound privacy filter is a library class with no route.
divergences.follow_up: Keep the codes listed; a route that starts emitting one records its HTTP status here.

divergences.summary: REST emits codes that the REST compatibility inventory and the protocol map do not list: input-validation leaf codes raised after a request is parsed, security_profile_invalid, json_structure_exceeded, the multimodal preflight codes, the OpenHIM mediator codes, and the stream_write_idle and stream_event_limit stream events. The inventory scanner reads literal and same-module constants only.
divergences.follow_up: Extend the REST compatibility inventory scanner to these call sites.

divergences.summary: AdmissionRejected declares a gRPC status and trailers, but the gRPC server does not use the admission controller; gRPC refuses with its own rate and concurrency reasons.
divergences.follow_up: Fair admission for gRPC, when it is scheduled.

divergences.summary: The protocol map lists three GraphQL codes; GraphQL also emits OPENMED_ADMISSION_REJECTED, OPENMED_GRAPHQL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, OPENMED_GRAPHQL_TIMEOUT, OPENMED_GRAPHQL_BATCH_UNSUPPORTED and shutting_down through named constants the protocol-map scanner does not resolve.
divergences.follow_up: A protocol-map update that resolves named code constants.

divergences.summary: A Python error that escapes a CLI command handler is reported as runtime_error with exit code 1; the shared code is not in the CLI envelope.
divergences.follow_up: A CLI change that forwards the shared code.

divergences.summary: grounding_failed names a failed grounding stage inside an MCP clinical tool result and a failed grounding-accuracy evaluation in the CLI gates command.
divergences.follow_up: A CLI change that gives the gate failure its own code.

divergences.summary: CLI commands raise command-local codes that the registry does not list; it records the dispatcher codes and every CLI code literal that is also a registry code, and the CLI exit code is only 0, 1 or 2.
divergences.follow_up: A decision on registering command-local CLI codes.
